name: sfx-music-manager
description: Local SFX & Music Manager for macOS

scripts.build:wasm: cd rust/sfx-parser && $HOME/.cargo/bin/wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir ../../src/main/wasm --release && echo 'WASM build OK'
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test:tauri:phase12: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run test:tauri:phase10 && node scripts/test-tauri-contract.mjs && python scripts/test-tauri-local-media.py
scripts.test:tauri:phase10: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features && node scripts/test-tauri-import.mjs && node scripts/test-tauri-preview.mjs && node scripts/test-tauri-transfer.mjs && node scripts/test-tauri-launcher.mjs && node scripts/test-tauri-media.mjs
scripts.test:tauri:phase7: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --test launcher_keys && node scripts/test-tauri-launcher.mjs
scripts.test:tauri:transfer: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --test transfer && node scripts/test-tauri-transfer.mjs
scripts.test:tauri:phase4: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --test preview && node scripts/test-tauri-preview.mjs
scripts.test:tauri:phase3: cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --lib --test indexer && node scripts/test-tauri-import.mjs
scripts.test:quicklauncher: npm run build:main && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron scripts/test-quick-launcher.cjs
scripts.test:downloader: npm run build:main && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron scripts/test-downloader.cjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:phase1 && npm run test:phase2 && npm run test:phase3 && npm run test:phase4 && npm run test:phase5 && npm run test:phase6 && npm run test:classifier && npm run test:dragdrop && npm run test:dragout && npm run test:exportwav && npm run test:exportmp3 && npm run test:bpm && npm run test:bounce && npm run test:quicklauncher && npm run test:downloader && npm run test:regressions
scripts.test:regressions: npm run build:main && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron scripts/test-regressions.cjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json
